description: A six-panel composite figure from two austenitic low-density steels (LDS) deformed to ε ≈ 0.15, mixing ACOM virtual bright-field (TEM-based) micrographs, phase maps, a misorientation profile and a KAM map. (a) Virtual bright-field micrograph of 28Mn0Ni (2 µm scale bar) with a white line labelled A-A' across a grain and two dashed arrows marking slip-band traces. (b) Matching 28Mn0Ni phase map, uniformly red, i.e. single-phase γ only. (c) Virtual bright-field micrograph of 15Mn5Ni (3 µm scale bar) with a white B-B' line crossing dark elongated B2 stringers and one dashed arrow. (d) Matching 15Mn5Ni phase map, red γ matrix with blue B2 particles/stringers; inset legend reads γ red, B2 blue. (e) Point-to-point misorientation profiles (x = Distance, µm, 0-5; y = Misorientation, °, 0-60): the blue A-A' curve stays within the lowest 10° interval, while the red B-B' curve shows plateaus a few degrees above the 10° gridline and three sharp peaks reaching between the 50 and 60° gridlines, ending near the 20° gridline. (f) KAM map (3 µm scale bar; colour bar Min 0 / Max 5) with green-yellow strain localisation along stringer-like features in γ. Together the panels argue that B2 stringers in 15Mn5Ni block slip, raising local misorientation and nucleating deformation twinning.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an ACOM virtual bright-field micrograph of 28Mn0Ni with a 2 µm scale bar, a white line labelled A-A' and two dashed arrows marking slip-band traces.
Panel (b), the 28Mn0Ni phase map (2 µm scale bar), is uniformly red across the whole field, indicating this region is single-phase γ with no B2 detected.
Panel (c) is a 15Mn5Ni virtual bright-field micrograph with a 3 µm scale bar, a white B-B' line crossing dark elongated stringers and one dashed arrow.
Panel (d) phase map (3 µm scale bar) shows a red γ matrix with blue B2 particles and elongated B2 stringers; the inset legend reads γ (red) and B2 (blue).
Panel (e) plots Misorientation (°) from 0 to 60 against Distance (µm) from 0 to 5, with two curves labelled A-A' and B-B'.

In panel (e) the A-A' curve remains within the lowest 10° interval over the whole profile, whereas the B-B' curve shows three sharp peaks reaching between the 50 and 60° gridlines separated by plateaus a few degrees above the 10° gridline, and ends near the 20° gridline.
Panel (f) is a KAM map with a 3 µm scale bar and a colour bar labelled Min 0 and Max 5; the highest (green-yellow) values are concentrated along elongated stringer-like features within the γ matrix.
The caption states the micrographs and phase maps are of (a,b) 28Mn0Ni and (c,d) 15Mn5Ni alloys deformed up to about 0.15 strain.

The caption states panel (e) is a misorientation profile taken across the A-A' line of Fig. 9a and the B-B' line of Fig. 9c, and panel (f) is a KAM map of strain distribution inside grains and interfaces surrounded by B2 in the 15Mn5Ni alloy.
The citing text states the point-to-point profile along B-B' confirms fine deformation twins with misorientation angles of ∼55–60° in the 15Mn5Ni alloy.
The citing text states the KAM map reveals increased strain localisation around fine B2 particles and stringers in the γ-matrix grains of the 15Mn5Ni alloy.

The caption calls panels (a) and (c) 'ACOM virtual bright-field micrographs', while the citing text refers to the same ACOM panels as image quality (IQ) maps — the two descriptions disagree on the imaging mode.
The caption mentions broken (dashed) arrows marking prominent slip band traces in the γ-grains of both alloys, which matches the dashed arrows visible in panels (a) and (c).

subfigures.description: ACOM virtual bright-field micrograph of 28Mn0Ni, 2 µm scale bar, showing one large grain with a white line labelled A-A' drawn across it and two dashed arrows pointing at slip-band traces at a boundary.
Phase map corresponding to (a) with a 2 µm scale bar: the whole field is red, i.e. a single-phase γ region; no B2 is resolved and no legend is printed in this panel.

ACOM virtual bright-field micrograph of 15Mn5Ni, 3 µm scale bar, showing dark elongated band-like features (B2 stringers) crossed by a white line labelled B-B', plus a dashed arrow marking a slip-band trace.
Phase map corresponding to (c), 3 µm scale bar: red γ matrix containing blue B2 particles and elongated B2 stringers; inset legend γ = red, B2 = blue.

Misorientation profile plot, y = Misorientation (°) 0-60, x = Distance (µm) 0-5, with two labelled curves: A-A' (lower, stays in the lowest 10° interval) and B-B' (upper, plateaus just above 10° with sharp peaks between the 50 and 60° gridlines, ending near 20°).
KAM (kernel average misorientation) map, 3 µm scale bar, colour bar labelled Min 0 and Max 5; green-yellow high-value regions decorate elongated stringer-like features on a blue (low) background.
